PCR Protocol for OneTaq® DNA Polymerase (M0480)
Set up the following reaction on ice:
Component25 μl reaction50 μl reactionFinal Concentration5X OneTaq Standard Reaction Buffer*5 µl10 μl1X10 mM dNTPs (#N0447)0.5 µl1 μl200 µM10 µM Forward Primer0.5 µl1 μl0.2 µM10 µM Reverse Primer0.5 µl1 μl0.2 µMOneTaq  DNA Polymerase0.125 µl0.25 µl1.25 units/50 µl PCR**Template DNAvariablevariable< 1,000 ngNuclease-free waterto 25 µlto 50 µl.  
Gently mix the reaction Collect all liquid to the bottom of the tube by a quick spin if necessary and overlay the sample with mineral oil  if using a PCR machine without a heated lid. 
Quickly transfer PCR tubes to a thermocycler preheated to the denaturation temperature (94°C) and begin thermocycling

script:
# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='5X OneTaq Standard Reaction Buffer', volume='5 µl or 10 µl', temperature='on ice', final_concentration='1X')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='10 mM dNTPs (#N0447)', volume='0.5 µl or 1 µl', temperature='on ice', final_concentration='200 µM')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='10 µM Forward Primer', volume='0.5 µl or 1 µl', temperature='on ice', final_concentration='0.2 µM')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='10 µM Reverse Primer', volume='0.5 µl or 1 µl', temperature='on ice', final_concentration='0.2 µM')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='OneTaq DNA Polymerase', volume='0.125 µl or 0.25 µl', temperature='on ice', final_concentration='1.25 units/50 µl PCR')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='Template DNA', volume='variable', temperature='on ice', max_amount='< 1,000 ng')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='Nuclease-free water', volume='to 25 µl or to 50 µl', temperature='on ice')
mix(container='PCR tube', temperature='on ice', speed='gently')
centrifuge(container='PCR tube', duration='quick spin', speed='quick', purpose='collect liquid to bottom')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='mineral oil', volume='overlay (volume not specified)', condition='if using PCR machine without heated lid')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: transfer (container: PCR tube, temperature: to thermocycler preheated to 94°C, speed: quickly)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='PCR tube (in thermocycler)', temperature='thermocycling (starting at 94°C)', duration='per PCR program')
